body: T12 NEW SPEC - Focus visible ring component (exam.html). PROBLEM: exam.html uses browser-default focus ring. On Chrome/Edge dark backgrounds the default blue ring is often invisible. Keyboard users cannot see which element has focus. BEHAVIOR: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, selects, radio options, links) show a 2px solid white outline with 2px offset on :focus-visible. Outline: 2px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.9), outline-offset: 2px. STATES: focus (ring visible), blur (no ring), focus via mouse (no ring per :focus-visible), focus via keyboard (ring visible). EDGE CASES: radio buttons inside .radio-group: apply outline to the label not the hidden input. Graph buttons: same ring style. Canvas: not applicable (not keyboard-focusable until graph keyboard spec ships). ACCEPT CRITERIA: Tab through exam in Chrome: every interactive element shows white ring when focused. Mouse click: no ring appears. Ring contrast: white on #141B2D (exam dark bg) = 19:1, PASS. Zero extra DOM elements needed. Pure CSS implementation.
